subject: Spontaneous application – Data Engineering Internship at Clarins
body: Dear Hiring Team at Clarins, I am a Computer Science master's student seeking an internship in Data Engineering. With hands-on experience developing Python scripts and writing SQL queries, I am eager to contribute to your data initiatives in the cosmetics sector. Please find my CV and cover letter attached; I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application. Kind regards, John Doe, Paris, john@example.com, +33 6 00 00 00 00

letter.name: John Doe
letter.subject: Spontaneous application – Data Engineering Internship
body: I am writing to express my interest in a Data Engineering internship at Clarins, a company in the cosmetics sector with an interest in data analytics.

I am a Computer Science master's student (Université Exemple, 2024–2026). During a previous internship as a development trainee in 2025 at Entreprise Exemple, I developed Python scripts and wrote SQL queries. I am also comfortable working in Linux, and I would like to apply these skills to support your data-related projects.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application and learn more about how I can contribute. Thank you for your time and consideration.

cv.name: John Doe
cv.headline: Étudiant en informatique – Stage en Data Engineering
cv.summary: Étudiant en Master informatique intéressé par l'ingénierie des données, avec expérience en développement de scripts Python et en écriture de requêtes SQL.
